description: This file defines a generic internal class TocTransactionQueue<TService> within the Orleans.Transactions.TOC namespace. It extends TransactionQueue and manages transaction commits by interacting with a specified service and storage components, utilizing Orleans configuration and timer functionalities.

classes.name: TocTransactionQueue<TService>
classes.description: An internal class managing transaction queue operations for transactions within the Orleans Transactions State Override namespace, parameterized by a service type.

methods.name: TocTransactionQueue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transaction queue with dependencies including service, options, storage, clock, logger, timer manager, and activation lifetime.

methods.name: OnLocalCommit
methods.description: Handles local commit logic by adding a precondition to storage and invoking base class commit handling.
